svg.title: Gemini 4 Argon launches on Google Cloud; calculate pricing from November 30, when introductory pricing ends
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Gemini 4 Argon launches on Google Cloud; calculate
pricing from November 30, when introductory pricing ends
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-18
Introductory pricing runs through
November 30, 2026
According to the Google Cloud blog, Argon’s
introductory price is $2 per 1 million input
tokens and $10 per 1 million output tokens.
Customer results were selected by the
company
The cloud blog included comments from GitLab,
Harvey, ServiceNow, and Figma.
Calculate input and output separately
For example, suppose a task uses 1 million input
tokens and 200,000 output tokens.
Checklist
First, check the input-to-output token ratio of
the Gemini model you currently use and Argon in
your usage logs.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
